title: C: Connect Four (Validation)
description: Validate a Connect Four board: check for horizontal, vertical, and diagonal wins.

steps.title: Check for Win
steps.description: Define a 6x7 Connect Four board as a 2D char array (0=empty, X=player1, O=player2). Write `int check_win(char board[6][7], char player)` that checks for 4-in-a-row in all directions. Test with a board that has a horizontal win for X.
hints: Check horizontal: scan each row for 4 consecutive.

verification.failureMessage: Check for X win (should be 1) and O win (should be 0)
